item.dc:creator: MT newswire
item.content:encoded: 03:35 PM EDT, 09/24/2026 (MT Newswires) -- Energy stocks rose late Thursday afternoon with the NYSE Energy Sector Index gaining 0.5% and the State Street Energy Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLE) adding 0.6%. The Philadelphia Oil Service Sector Index fell 0.4%, and the Dow Jones US Utilities Index shed 0.6%. West Texas Intermediate crude oil rose 3.2% to $95.15 a barrel, and global benchmark Brent climbed 4% to $107.19 a barrel. Henry Hub natural gas futures surged 9.2% to $3.30 per 1 million BTU. In corporate news, BP (BP) is considering a potential acquisition of Devon Energy's (DVN) operations in South Texas as part of renewed efforts to expand its US shale assets, Reuters reported. BP shares eased 0.3%, and Devon rose 1.3%.

item.title: Nyrstar launches strategic review of Dutch zinc smelting operations
item.description: Nyrstar, owned by commodities group Trafigura, has launched a strategic review of its loss-making Budel zinc smelting operations in the Netherlands due to r
item.dc:creator: Mining.com
item.content:encoded: Nyrstar, owned by commodities group Trafigura, has launched a strategic review of its loss-making Budel zinc smelting operations in the Netherlands due to rising energy costs and government policies, it said on Thursday. Operations to produce the metal mainly used to galvanise steel will continue as normal during the review, which is expected to conclude by the end of 2026, Nyrstar added in a statement. “Nyrstar Budel faces significant pressure in terms of tough market conditions, elevated energy prices and historically low treatment and refining charges over a sustained period,” said CEO Guido Janssen. “The operation is losing money every year and the conditions for next year look particularly difficult, given rising energy costs, together with a lack of supportive government policy.” Adding to the pressure was a decision by the Dutch government not to include provisions for grid cost mitigation for energy-intensive industries in its 2027 budget, Nyrstar said. The Budel smelter, with a capacity to produce 315,000 metric tons per year of zinc, was suspended in the second half of January 2024 due to high energy costs and restarted in May of that year. “This is a significant decision point for Budel. The review will allow us to carefully assess the site’s position and the options available, while continuing to consider whether concrete action can materially improve the business case,” Janssen said. (Reporting by Eric Onstad; Editing by Susan Fenton)

item.title: MercadoLibre launches deliveries within an hour, expands pharmacy business in Brazil
item.description: Adds details in bullets 1-3 SAO PAULO, Sept 24 (Reuters) - MercadoLibre MELI.O launched product deliveries within an hour in Brazil, starting in the city of
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Adds details in bullets 1-3 SAO PAULO, Sept 24 (Reuters) - MercadoLibre MELI.O launched product deliveries within an hour in Brazil, starting in the city of Sao Paulo, Fernando Yunes, the firm's executive vice president of commerce, said on Thursday. The Latin American e-commerce and fintech company also will expand its pharmacy business in the country, with its own pharmacy in Sao Paulo beginning to sell prescription products this month, Yunes said at a company event. MercadoLibre will add third-party pharmacies to its e-commerce platform in Brazil as of October, kicking off in Sao Paulo with three drugstore chains, which were not named. The company expects to have 20 third-party physical drugstore locations in Sao Paulo on its platform by the end of the year. The one-hour service, which started as a test in an undisclosed region of Sao Paulo and is expected to be expanded, will include products such as medications, food and others. (Reporting by Andre Romani; Editing by Chris Reese and Cynthia Osterman) ((fernando.cardoso@thomsonreuters.com;))
